title: AutoTTV: automated transit-timing pipeline for TESS, v1.0.0
description: AutoTTV is an automated Bayesian pipeline for homogeneous transit-timing analysis of TESS Objects of Interest (TOIs). It fits the phase-folded light curve with an analytic transit model sampled by Markov chain Monte Carlo, measures individual mid-transit times with the transit shape held fixed, and searches the timing residuals for periodic signals, long-term period changes and excess scatter. This release accompanies Shporer & Drori, "AutoTTV: Homogeneous Transit Timing of 3,650 TESS TOIs and the Radius Bias of Strict-Period Phase Folding" (submitted to ApJS).
